summary: GI round 4, package PI (the inventory), declared BEFORE any code: three reading changes in studio/gi/services.py, one parameter in validation/checks.required_fact_states and one argument in validation/engine._proposal. (1) The instrument as the subject of its own reach ('The colonoscope reached the cecum') states its service performed in the inventory - only where the document carries a procedure report's own head (sections.procedure_report_head), its head is no note written around a procedure (sections.around_procedure_title), the instrument is not under another occurrence (sections.under_another_occurrence), its clause carries no date and the inventory's reading is otherwise silent. Implemented as a guarded promotion in _build's instrument pass with new _pi_ helpers; the module-wide ACT_VERB is NOT widened, because a regex cannot carry the head guard and the unguarded form (the minimal design's tree_c) reads the copied 'The colonoscope reached the cecum' of a records review as performed (judge rows J1-J3, H3 records documents). (2) Paragraph carry (A1): with more than one family performed, an act or lesion no part, name or site gives a family takes the family its paragraph last named - same part, never a history, plan or indication part, never a field or box row, within CARRY_REACH characters with no blank line between, the carried family itself performed, every region the clause or sentence names one that family reaches, and a sentence naming two families clears the carry. (3) E1: where routing reads no extent and does not read the family as done today, a performed service the inventory reads complete by its own endpoint statement takes the deepest endpoint landmark those statements name (routing's labels; EGD and colonoscopy only), never from a statement in a history or plan section (layout of the text the inventory reads and of the original), under another occurrence, carrying an extent word, or after an extent label; checks.required_fact_states uses that extent only when routing has no extent fact and does not read the family positive; engine._proposal passes the matched service. (4) The hold-only W1 guard: an indwelling stent's state ('The existing stent was in position and draining.') is not a performed act - applied only where the same service documents another stent performed (a new stent placed beside it still counts), so removing the phantom can never release a base-included hold or an unresolved item. NOTE, declared now: this guard does NOT hold h2-10's 43274 - 43274 covers the new stent placed across the stricture, which stays performed; the plan's 'so h2-10's 43274 is held' does not follow from the guard as specified (holding it needs the stent exchange read as its own act, the W1 vocabulary the plan parks for a coder or the owner).
